## Personality

Conseil is a phlegmatic and imperturbable individual, characterized by a calm, polite, and ceremonious demeanor. He maintains a self-possessed nature that remains unfazed even under extraordinary circumstances. Highly knowledgeable in the field of conchology, he possesses a specialized skill for classifying fish and marine life. Furthermore, he is noted for being both prudent and remarkably dexterous, proving quick with his hands when navigating obstacles.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER III I FORM MY RESOLUTION P4](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER III I FORM MY RESOLUTION P6](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0006), [v1 CHAPTER V AT A VENTURE P8](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER VII AN UNKNOWN SPECIES OF WHALE P22](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0022), [v1 CHAPTER VII AN UNKNOWN SPECIES OF WHALE P25](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0025), [v1 CHAPTER VIII MOBILIS IN MOBILI P5](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0005), +12 more_

## History

Conseil, a devoted Flemish servant, accompanied his master, Professor [Aronnax](../character/professor-aronnax.md), on an expedition aboard the [Abraham Lincoln](../codex/tech.md#abraham-lincoln) to locate a mysterious sea monster. After being thrown overboard during the hunt, Conseil and [Aronnax](../character/professor-aronnax.md) were rescued by [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md), only to be captured and imprisoned aboard the advanced submarine, the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus). Under the command of Captain [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md), the three men were forced to live as captives while traversing the world's oceans. Conseil participated in numerous underwater excursions, including hunting in the forests of [Crespo](../codex/places.md#crespo) and witnessing the ruins of [Atlantis](../codex/places.md#atlantis). Throughout their journey, he remained a loyal companion to [Aronnax](../character/professor-aronnax.md), even as tensions rose regarding their captivity and Nemo's violent actions. Conseil narrowly survived dangerous encounters with sharks, hostile islanders, and giant cuttlefish while aboard the vessel. As Nemo's behavior grew increasingly erratic and vengeful, Conseil joined his companions in planning a desperate escape. Their attempt to flee in a small boat coincided with the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) being drawn into the Maelstrom off the coast of [Norway](../codex/places.md#norway). The violent currents tore the boat away, leaving the three men to be washed ashore on the Loffoden Isles. Conseil ultimately survived the ordeal, finding safety in a fisherman's hut alongside his master and [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER III I FORM MY RESOLUTION P3](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER III I FORM MY RESOLUTION P4](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER III I FORM MY RESOLUTION P5](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0005), [v1 CHAPTER III I FORM MY RESOLUTION P7](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0007), [v1 CHAPTER III I FORM MY RESOLUTION P9](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0009), [v1 CHAPTER III I FORM MY RESOLUTION P11](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0011), +994 more_

## Relationships

### [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/conseil--ned-land.md)

Conseil and [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) have been fellow captives since their shared experience being thrown overboard from the [Abraham Lincoln](../codex/tech.md#abraham-lincoln) and subsequently abducted by the crew of the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus). They maintain a close companionship as they navigate the uncertainty of their imprisonment together. While Conseil remains focused on his duties, he shares the common struggle of confinement with the harpooner, who often expresses his frustration through outbursts.

- Comrade of — fellow passenger on the Nautilus  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER VII AN UNKNOWN SPECIES OF WHALE P59](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0059), [v1 CHAPTER VIII MOBILIS IN MOBILI P1](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER IX NED LAND’S TEMPERS P22](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0022), +39 more</sub>
- Friend of — close companions  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER VIII MOBILIS IN MOBILI P5](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0005), [v1 CHAPTER IX NED LAND’S TEMPERS P19](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0019), [v1 CHAPTER XIV A NOTE OF INVITATION P0](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0000), +7 more</sub>

### [Professor Aronnax](../character/professor-aronnax.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/conseil--professor-aronnax.md)

Conseil serves as the devoted servant and assistant to Professor [Aronnax](../character/professor-aronnax.md), a role he has maintained throughout their time together on the [Abraham Lincoln](../codex/tech.md#abraham-lincoln) and their subsequent captivity on the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus). He remains steadfastly by the Professor's side, accompanying him during excursions such as the hunting trip to the island of [Crespo](../codex/places.md#crespo). Their bond is defined by Conseil's unwavering loyalty and his commitment to supporting the Professor's scientific interests even while they are held as prisoners.

- Serves under — servant  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER VIII MOBILIS IN MOBILI P23](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0023)</sub>
- Comrade of — servant and companion on the Nautilus  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XIV A NOTE OF INVITATION P16](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0016), [v2 CHAPTER X THE SUBMARINE COAL-MINES P27](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0027), [v2 CHAPTER XII CACHALOTS AND WHALES P64](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0064), +1 more</sub>
